title.zh: 【Paradigm CTO：本周将发布 Solidity 编译器 Solar 的 EVM 代码生成功能】
title.en: 【Paradigm CTO：本周将发布 Solidity 编译器 Solar 的 EVM 代码生成功能】

current_state.zh: Paradigm CTO Georgios Konstantopoulos said the team will release Solar's EVM code-generation feature this week, claiming compilation over 100x faster than solc and more gas-efficient bytecode without requiring assembly, following earlier teasers of a JIT-based evm2.
